seam.noPrevious: This shot has no previous shot.
seam.saveFirst: The project could not be saved: no image extracted.
seam.replaceFirstMessage: “{shot}” already has a first frame. The new image replaces it; you can undo.

seam.error.noTake: The previous shot has no finished take with a file.
